basic_details.job_title: OFBL Danger Building Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 70 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Ordnance Factory Badmal (OFBL), Balangir, Odisha, has invited applications for 70 posts of Danger Building Worker (DBW) under Advt No. 1002/Tenure/PER(RC)/OFBL/2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 17 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Between 18 and 40 years for General Candidates (as on the closing date of receipt of application)

qualification.education_qualification: National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT in AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant) trade; feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic) considered only if AOCP candidates are not available.
qualification.details: Qualification: Certification: NCVT - National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCTVT now NCVT; Trade: AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant); Feeder Trades: IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic Age limit: Between 18 and 40 years for General Candidates (as on the closing date of receipt of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years (only in respect of the post reserved for SC/ST), OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 03 years (only in respect of the post reserved for OBC), Ex-Serviceman Period of Military Service + 03 years | Other conditions: | Must be a citizen of India Priority to AOCP trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and of Government/Private organisations having Government affiliation Compulsory one-month in-house explosives safety training after selection; feeder trade candidates also get two months on-job training Consent/undertaking to be engaged as DBW/CPW will be obtained from feeder trade candidates

salary_details.pay_scale: Basic Pay Rs.19900 (Skilled level) plus DA, HRA, Risk Allowance and Night Duty Allowance as admissible

exam_pattern.details: Medium of Trade/Practical Test: English / Hindi (as chosen in application form)

how_to_apply: Download and print the Application Form and fill it in BLOCK LETTERS only.
Ink-sign the form and attach the necessary enclosures and one extra self-attested photograph.
Superscribe the envelope 'APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF TENURE BASED DBW ON CONTRACT BASIS'.
Send by post only to The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Badmal, PO - Badmal, District - Balangir, Pin - 767070, ODISHA.
Application must be received within 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 17 December 2026.
important_instructions: Applications received after the closing date or not meeting eligibility will be summarily rejected OF Badmal not responsible for postal delay Only shortlisted candidates informed by e-mail/post; admit cards and engagement letters sent by e-mail/post No enquiry by phone/messenger; canvassing leads to disqualification Disputes subject to Courts / Tribunals in Odisha only

content_sections.heading: OFBL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 1002/Tenure/PER(RC)/OFBL/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download OFBL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Certification: NCVT - National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCTVT now NCVT; Trade: AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant); Feeder Trades: IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic Age limit: Between 18 and 40 years for General Candidates (as on the closing date of receipt of application) Age relaxation: SC/ST 05 years (only in respect of the post reserved for SC/ST), OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 03 years (only in respect of the post reserved for OBC), Ex-Serviceman Period of Military Service + 03 years Other conditions: Must be a citizen of India Priority to AOCP trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and of Government/Private organisations having Government affiliation Compulsory one-month in-house explosives safety training after selection; feeder trade candidates also get two months on-job training Consent/undertaking to be engaged as DBW/CPW will be obtained from feeder trade candidates

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for OFBL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates belonging to PwBD category - post not identified for PwBD

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract basis initially for ONE year, may be extended up to a maximum of FOUR years including initial period Tenure ends automatically on completion of four years from date of joining No right to claim regular employee status; no commitment for absorption or extension Termination by one month's notice by either party or pay of Basic Pay + DA in lieu Performance assessed half-yearly; Poor rating twice can lead to termination with 15 days' notice

content_sections.heading: How Will OFBL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on NCVT (NAC) marks, category-wise merit Document Verification Trade/Practical Test (same day) Category-wise merit list (80% NAC marks + 20% Trade/Practical Test) Candidates called for Document Verification and Trade/Practical Test category-wise in order of NCVT (NAC) marks Cut-off percentage for call decided by OF Badmal on total NCVT (NAC) marks Trade/Practical Test on the same day as Document Verification for those found eligible Merit list category-wise: NCVT (NAC) 80% and Trade/Practical Test 20% weightage Ties: ex-apprentice of OF Badmal, then of other Ordnance Factories, then higher NAC marks, then elder candidate

content_sections.heading: OFBL Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Medium of Trade/Practical Test: English / Hindi (as chosen in application form)

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Copy of Xth / SSLC Certificate (proof of Date of Birth) and other educational certificates and mark sheets Copy of National Trade Certificate and Mark Sheet in AOCP / other trade Copy of Aadhar Card; Experience Certificate, if any Caste/Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS) in prescribed proforma; OBC-NCL declaration as per Appendix-I; Ex-serviceman proof Two photographs (one pasted on form) and one extra photograph with name and date of birth on back

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after the closing date or not meeting eligibility will be summarily rejected OF Badmal not responsible for postal delay Only shortlisted candidates informed by e-mail/post; admit cards and engagement letters sent by e-mail/post No enquiry by phone/messenger; canvassing leads to disqualification Disputes subject to Courts / Tribunals in Odisha only

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OFBL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in OFBL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 70 vacancies for Danger Building Worker (DBW).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for OFBL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application Form printed in the advertisement (pages 8-10), with Appendix-I OBC (NCL) declaration (page 11)) and send it to The Chief General Manager, Ordnance Factory Badmal, PO - Badmal, District - Balangir, Pin - 767070, ODISHA, by by post, to reach by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All candidates: NIL.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 and 40 years for General Candidates (as on the closing date of receipt of application). Relaxation: SC/ST 05 years (only in respect of the post reserved for SC/ST), OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) 03 years (only in respect of the post reserved for OBC), Ex-Serviceman Period of Military Service + 03 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Basic Pay Rs.19900 (Skilled level) plus DA, HRA, Risk Allowance and Night Duty Allowance as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) from NCVT in AOCP (Attendant Operator Chemical Plant) trade; feeder trades (IMCP, MMCP, LACP, PPO, Fitter General, Machinist, Turner, Sheet Metal Worker, Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Boiler Attendant, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Mechanic) considered only if AOCP candidates are not available.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a citizen of India. Priority to AOCP trade apprentices of Ordnance Factories and of Government/Private organisations having Government affiliation. Compulsory one-month in-house explosives safety training after selection; feeder trade candidates also get two months on-job training. Consent/undertaking to be engaged as DBW/CPW will be obtained from feeder trade candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to PwBD category - post not identified for PwBD.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on NCVT (NAC) marks, category-wise merit. Document Verification. Trade/Practical Test (same day). Category-wise merit list (80% NAC marks + 20% Trade/Practical Test).
